title: Anti-inflammatory effects of a casein hydrolysate and its peptide-enriched fractions on TNFa-challenged Caco-2 cells and LPS-challenged porcine colonic explants

what_it_measured.text: Anti-inflammatory effects of a casein hydrolysate and its peptide-enriched fractions on TNFα-challenged Caco-2 cells and LPS-challenged porcine colonic explants

dose.text: These TNFa-treated Caco-2 cells were simultaneously cotreated with casein hydrolysates or fractions at an increasing concentration of 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2.5, and 5 mg/mL to optimize the concentration for the highest anti-inflammatory activity.

Tissue explants from each animal was: (1) incubated in the presence of bacterial LPS, (Sigma Aldrich Corp.) at a concentration of 10 μg/mL (challenged tissue); (2) in the presence of LPS (10 μg/mL) and casein hydrolysate and fractions (1 mg/mL); and (3) in sterile DMEM (unchallenged tissue).

endpoint.text: The expression of a panel of inflammatory cytokines was measured using qPCR.
Following this, interleukin (IL)-8 concentrations in the supernatant were measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.
After 24 h, the media was collected and IL-8 levels were measured using Human CXCL8/IL-8 ELISA kit, as mentioned in the above section.

reported_results.text: In the ex vivo system, only the 1 kDaR fraction elicited a decrease in IL1-α, IL1-β, IL-8, TGF-β and IL-10 expression (P < 0.05).
While dexamethasone reduced the IL-8 concentration by 41.6%, the 1 kDaR and 1 kDaP fractions reduced IL-8 by 68.7% and 66.1%, respectively, relative to TNFα-stimulated Caco-2 cells (P < 0.05).
Similarly, co-treatment with NaCAS or EH or 5 kDaR resulted in a reduction of 31.1% (P < 0.05), 31% (P < 0.05) and 32.7% (P < 0.05),
Co-treatment with dexamethasone resulted in a 41.6% reduction in IL-8 concentration (P < 0.05) relative to control.
The enzymatic hydrolysis of NaCAS decreased the abundance of material >10 kDa and increased the abundance of material <5 kDa (P < 0.001).
The % reduction values are relative to control (TNFa stimulated) Caco-2 cells. *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, n = 3. 1
